userStories.title: Gate file schema + fail-closed I/O module
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need a durable, schema-validated gate file (.claude/.cam-gate.json) with fail-closed read/write/remove helpers so that operator-decision pauses persist across sidecar restarts exactly like the existing durable-marker family.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/supervisor/gate.ts exports a GATE_FILENAME constant ('.cam-gate.json') and a CamGate type shaped { gate: string, options: string[], context: string, decision?: string }. [oracle: grep -q "GATE_FILENAME" src/supervisor/gate.ts]

A JSON-schema file scripts/cam/cam-gate.schema.json defines .claude/.cam-gate.json as { gate: string, options: string[], context: string, decision?: string } with gate/options/context required. [oracle: file-assert test -f scripts/cam/cam-gate.schema.json]

A fail-closed validating reader rejects a malformed, absent, or partially-written gate file (throws or returns a typed error, never returns a partially-parsed object); a separate lenient reader returns null when the file is absent. Proven by a behavioral test hitting a real tmpdir gate file. [oracle: bun test]

write and remove helpers mirror plan-escalation.ts (durable write via writeFileSync, remove is a silent no-op when absent, neither throws); round-trip (write then read then remove) is covered by a behavioral test against a real tmpdir. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New: src/supervisor/gate.ts, scripts/cam/cam-gate.schema.json. Mirror src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts (read/write/remove + JSON reader shape guard: validate discriminator fields, not just typeof) and drain-kill-switch.ts (injectable fs seams). GOTCHA (spec): the gate object (array + free-text) does NOT belong in the flat-scalar cam-loop.local.md frontmatter; it lives in a dedicated .claude/.cam-gate.json alongside .cam-plan-escalated.json / .cam-ship-stalled.json / .cam-implement-blocked.json. Existing schemas live at scripts/cam/*.schema.json (handoff/issues/orch-handoff). Test-quality invariant: real tmpdir I/O, no tautological mock-call assertions.

userStories.title: `cam decide <decision>` CLI thin-proxy
userStories.description: As the operator, I need a `cam decide <decision>` command that records my choice into the active gate file so that the sidecar can resume deterministically, with the signal as the single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: `cam decide <decision>` reads the active gate file, validates <decision> is a member of the active gate's options[], and writes decision into the SAME gate file (single source of truth, no split across the loop file). [oracle: bun test]
An invalid decision (not in options[]) exits non-zero with a clear error that lists the valid options; the gate file is left unmodified. [oracle: bun test]
Running `cam decide` when no gate file is active exits non-zero with a clear 'no gate active' error. [oracle: bun test]
The command is registered in index.ts dispatch and appears in the CLI help surface, as a DISTINCT verb from the existing `cam resume` command. [oracle: grep -q "decide" index.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New: src/commands/decide.ts; wire into index.ts (argv[2] dispatch + help spec, mirror the `cam resume`/`cam drain` command entries around index.ts:71-127,774-808). GOTCHA (spec): do NOT overload the existing `cam resume` (4-mode interrupt recovery, src/commands/resume.ts); the decision channel is the new verb `cam decide`. Decision is written back into the SAME gate file the sidecar polls (avoid split-brain). Reuse the fail-closed reader + CamGate type from src/supervisor/gate.ts (US-001).

userStories.title: Sidecar generic gate lifecycle: write+notify, poll+resolve+clear+flip
userStories.description: As the cam sidecar, I need to write an operator-decision gate (phase:awaiting-operator + gate file) and notify the orchestrator, then poll for the operator's decision and resolve it deterministically, so that awaiting-operator becomes an active resumable state rather than a passive dead-end.
acceptanceCriteria: When the sidecar reaches an operator-decision point it writes phase:awaiting-operator to cam-loop.local.md AND writes .claude/.cam-gate.json with gate/options/context, and pushes a one-line notify to the orchestrator pane naming the gate + options + context; it never auto-selects an option. [oracle: bun test]

The sidecar polls the gate file for a populated decision, re-validates it against options[], executes the corresponding resolution path (dispatched generically by the gate discriminator, NOT hard-coded to a single gate kind), deletes the gate file, and flips phase accordingly. [oracle: bun test]
A decision that fails re-validation is ignored (never executed) and the sidecar keeps polling. [oracle: bun test]

A stale gate file left by a crashed prior run is cleared at gate-write time (mirroring clearStalePlanArtifacts), and the gate file is deleted on resolution (consumed-on-resolution). [oracle: bun test]
Async waits in the sidecar-poll tests use waitForCondition (test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts), never a fixed sleep, and hit a real tmpdir gate file. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/sidecar.ts (gate write + poll integrated into the outer loop's phase handling; see makeSetPhaseFn at sidecar.ts:893 and the phase:awaiting-operator branch), optionally a notify-line formatter in src/supervisor/gate.ts. GOTCHA (spec): the gate shape is deliberately GENERIC (gate discriminator + options[] + context) because CAM-149 (ship pauses) and CAM-139 (drain kill-switch) reuse the exact same primitive + `cam decide`; the resolution dispatch must be keyed by the gate discriminator with the in-progress-conflict handler registered by US-004, not inlined here. phase:awaiting-operator already exists in the LoopPhase enum (src/commands/status.ts:92) but is passive today; this story makes it active/resumable. Notify to orchestrator pane via the existing tmux send-keys path (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) atomic text+Enter. Sidecar is the sole writer of the gate on the machine side; the orchestrator only narrates.

userStories.title: In-progress-work conflict gate at plan start
userStories.description: As the cam sidecar, I need to detect in-progress work when a plan is requested and pause on an in-progress-conflict gate so that starting a new plan never silently clobbers an unfinished PRD or a live feature branch.
acceptanceCriteria: At runPlanPhase start (before selecting/dispatching an issue), the sidecar deterministically detects (a) an existing prd.json carrying a passes:false non-operator story, OR (b) HEAD on a cam/* branch. [oracle: bun test]

On detection it writes an in-progress-conflict gate with options EXACTLY [continue, ship, abandon] via the US-003 generic primitive and pauses before any issue selection/dispatch happens. [oracle: bun test]

Resolution paths: continue -> phase:implementing (resume the existing PRD); abandon -> deterministically rm handoff.json + discard prd/branch state, then proceed with the requested plan; ship -> phase:shipping (the pending plan request is dropped). [oracle: bun test]
No conflict detected (clean prd.json + not on a cam/* branch) proceeds straight to normal plan-phase issue selection with no gate written. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (detection at the top of runPlanPhase, plan-runner.ts:904, BEFORE selectIssueFn; the detection must run before clearStalePlanArtifacts destroys state it inspects, or read prd/branch state independently), src/commands/sidecar.ts (register the in-progress-conflict resolution handler into US-003's generic dispatch). Branch check: git HEAD symbolic-ref matches cam/*. prd non-operator passes:false story: mirror decideNextAction's partition (src/supervisor/decide.ts). GOTCHA (spec): item 4 plan_approval=operator full-PRD gate is OUT of scope (split issue); item 3 BLOCK->re-plan loop is ALREADY SHIPPED (v0.73.0) - do NOT re-implement. abandon path is destructive (rm handoff.json + discard prd/branch): make it deterministic and test it against a real tmpdir.
